title: rxn-1: add wolfSSL_Mutex global and init/free in C_Initialize/C_Finalize
description: Add a static wolfSSL_Mutex g_lock to wp11_pkcs11.c. Call wc_InitMutex in C_Initialize (after checking not already initialized). Call wc_FreeMutex in C_Finalize. Add WP11_LOCK/WP11_UNLOCK macros. Document: C_GetFunctionList is the only C_* that must work pre-init (per PKCS#11 spec), so it does not acquire the lock.
